The following events took place in '''3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''':<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref>

==Events==
*The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], reeling from the loss of their [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] and [[Darth Malgus]]' betrayal, launches a renewed assault upon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to regain their momentum, with [[Darth Karrid]] leading the assault from the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]''.<ref name="Annihilation" />
